signal: Nitro, now part of Alludo, is pushing AI and cloud across its Nitro Workspace PDF and Sign suite in a PDF market estimated at 5.29B euros for 2026.

email.body1:
Serena, saw Nitro pushing AI and cloud across Nitro Workspace under the Alludo umbrella.

When the platform expands, RevOps usually feels the signal-to-action gap first: real buying signals land but reps cannot research, write, and follow up fast enough to act on them. Our AI SDR closes that loop autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nitro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Serena, quick follow-up for Nitro.

Most RevOps leaders know signals are slipping through before reps touch them, but the lift from fixing it is hard to quantify until you see it. Our best-practice changes alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of Nitro's current outbound, three things I would change, and how each maps to measurable pipeline lift without adding headcount.
email.body3:
Serena, last bit of proof for Nitro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nitro's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Serena, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If closing the signal-to-action gap without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know running RevOps through a platform shift is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Nitro either way.
